content.text:
<document id=DOC_posting_odd_headers>
What you will need on day one.
1. Python.
2. SQL.

What would make you stand out.
3. Grafana.
4. Technical writing.
</document>

The posting below groups its requirements under headers. Say for each
header whether the requirements under it are mandatory or optional, and
say what in the header told you.

response.text:
**"What you will need on day one."**: mandatory
- Requirements: Python, SQL
- Header cues: "Need" means these are required, not preferred. "On day one" means you must have them when you start, not pick them up on the job.

**"What would make you stand out."**: optional
- Requirements: Grafana, technical writing
- Header cues: "Stand out" means these set you apart from other candidates who already meet the baseline, so they're bonuses rather than conditions. "Would" is conditional: having them helps, but lacking them doesn't disqualify you.

The numbering runs 1–4 across both sections, which could make it look like one list. The headers are what separate the required items from the nice-to-have ones.
